title: Building an Effective Software Engineer Portfolio & Tech Blog
transcript:
The most underrated superpower of a portfolio is technical writing.
Having 2 or 3 in-depth technical blog posts on your portfolio establishes you as an authority in your field.
A hiring manager sees that you can explain complex architectural concepts clearly to other human beings.
Key elements:
1. Interactive code playgrounds or interactive diagrams (using MDX).
2. Clean reading typography: 18px to 20px font size, 1.6 to 1.7 line height, and a maximum reading line length of 65 characters (max-width: 65ch).
3. Search and filtering for articles and projects.
4. High performance: pre-render all pages statically with Next.js SSG or Astro. A developer portfolio should load in under 500 milliseconds.
